entities.summary: De Administrando Imperio is a Greek-language historiographical work written by the 10th-century Byzantine Emperor Constantine VII (945-959). It is a domestic and foreign policy manual for the use of Constantine's son and successor, the Emperor Romanos II (959-963). It is a prominent example of Byzantine encyclopaedism.
